title: NexusBeacon
description: Advanced and customizable beacon system for modern Minecraft servers.
body:
![nexusbeacon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/93d7e2aeaa68abc523f43699a945a60c98f34899_0.webp)
NexusBeacon is an advanced and fully customizable beacon framework designed for modern Minecraft servers.

Create powerful beacon structures with upgradeable effects, visual beam styles, configurable power systems, custom GUIs and performance-oriented mechanics.

Unlike traditional beacon plugins, NexusBeacon focuses on modularity, flexibility and server integration while keeping a clean vanilla-friendly experience.

Features
✔ Custom beacon progression system
✔ Upgradeable effects with configurable costs
✔ Potion and advanced custom effects
✔ Visual beam styles with particles and colors
✔ Configurable power scaling system
✔ Dynamic beacon ranges
✔ Fully customizable GUIs
✔ YAML / SQLite / MySQL support
✔ PlaceholderAPI support
✔ Vault support
✔ Modern Minecraft support (1.21+)
✔ Performance-oriented architecture
✔ Multi-language support
✔ Highly configurable

Visual Beam System
NexusBeacon includes a fully customizable visual beam renderer.

Features:
Multiple beam styles
Custom particles
RGB / HEX colors
Global or per-player styles
Dynamic beam rendering
Custom material detection
Lightweight rendering system
![ray](https://dynacraft.cl/assets/images/nb_ray.png)
​
Create unique beacon identities using different base materials and visual effects.

![custom](https://dynacraft.cl/assets/images/nb_custom.png) ​

Effect System
Effects are fully configurable through YAML.

Includes:

Potion effects
Crop growth boosts
Furnace acceleration
Damage fields
Gravity pulse
Mob burning
Spawner acceleration
Custom effect scaling
![gui](https://dynacraft.cl/assets/images/nb_gui.png)
​
Each effect supports:

Multiple levels
Power consumption
Custom upgrade costs
Dynamic descriptions
Independent balancing
Performance
NexusBeacon was designed with performance in mind.

The plugin includes:

Tick-limited processing
Configurable scan limits
Radius optimization
Lightweight beam rendering
Cooldown systems
Optional integrations
Most systems are configurable to fit both small survival servers and large networks.

GUI System
The GUI framework is fully configurable.

You can:

Create custom layouts
Move buttons freely
Customize icons and lore
Open nested menus
Use placeholders dynamically
Create server-specific interfaces
No recompiling required.

Storage Support
Supported storage types:

YAML
SQLite
MySQL / MariaDB
Storage migration is built directly into the plugin.

Compatibility
Supported integrations:

Vault
PlaceholderAPI
SpawnerMeta
Installation
Download NexusBeacon
Place the plugin inside your /plugins/ folder
Start the server
Configure the plugin files
Restart or reload NexusBeacon
Documentation
Wiki:
https://github.com/Karuho/NexusBeacon/wiki

Customization
Create fully customizable beacon systems for your server with unique visuals and modular gameplay mechanics.
